summary: Iter-43 acceptance test for P1 must-change-password-on-first-login + targeted regression on role isolation and Phase-2 Kumul Agencies dashboard investigation. Executed: (1) SAFETY GATE — DB_NAME=test_database (isolated), MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 (not production), preview URL matches request, branch confirmed not main, records prefixed 'E2E-TEST-20260819' where created. Admin login regression intact (system_admin token). (3) NEW iter-43 role-isolation suite 9/9 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iter43_role_isolation.py: unauth /workspace and /auth/me = 401, admin can reach /property-advertising/workspace = 200, admin token REJECTED (401/403) on PUT /advertiser/drafts/current (staff cannot post as advertiser), fresh advertiser CAN reach own draft (200/404), fresh advertiser BLOCKED (401/403) from /workspace, fresh-advertiser backend payload from /advertiser/me + /advertiser/submissions contains NO 'kumul agencies' / 'executive office space' strings, and no pa_advertisers doc exists linking the fresh user to owner_name~/Kumul/i. (4) PHASE 2 INVESTIGATION RESOLVED — code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/advertiser/AdvertiserWorkspace.jsx confirms 'Welcome back, Kumul Agencies!' (line 161), KPI cards 18/6/5/42 (line 163), the 4 sample properties (lines 37-42), enquiries/inspections/documents tables (lines 187/189/191), and Profile/Business fields (line 193) are all HARD-CODED STATIC MOCK strings — NOT data fetched from backend. Only DraftContext.load() actually calls /property-advertising/advertiser/drafts/current + /submissions and only mutates the Add-Property form + syncSubmissionProperties() list. Verdict: NOT a cross-account leak; classified as HIGH-priority MOCKED integration that must be replaced with real per-user data + counts before production. (5) FE PROTECTED ROUTE smoke: /advertiser unauth redirects to /add-property?auth=login; /admin/property-advertising unauth redirects to /admin/login; home page loads with no console errors and no .error elements. Total automated assertions passed this iteration: 18/18.

critical_code_review_comments: AdvertiserWorkspace.jsx line 37-42 defines a module-level mutable `properties` array which is mutated by syncSubmissionProperties(). This is anti-pattern React state and will cause cross-request contamination if the module is ever kept warm between users (SSR / worker). Move into DraftProvider state.

AdvertiserWorkspace.jsx is 197 dense lines but its formatting is severely one-lined (multi-hundred-char JSX lines). Split into per-page components and format normally — currently very hard to review or diff for auth-sensitive changes.

iter-43 role-isolation confirms admin CANNOT PUT advertiser draft — good — but there is no explicit backend integration test yet that a staff token is rejected by every /advertiser/* mutation endpoint (submit, drafts, etc). Add coverage.

P1 rate limit is in-memory sliding window (8/15min login, 10/15min pw-change) — not durable across backend restarts. Document this operational caveat; in a multi-instance deploy limits will be per-process.

rca_of_the_issue: No new defect discovered this iteration; the Kumul Agencies dashboard content — the single item flagged CRITICAL in the request — is FE static mock, root-caused to hard-coded literals in /app/frontend/src/pages/advertiser/AdvertiserWorkspace.jsx (Dashboard() at line 161-166, plus PropertiesPage/EnquiriesPage/InspectionsPage/DocumentsPage/AccountSettings), NOT a backend data leak. Backend /advertiser/me and /advertiser/submissions correctly return only the calling user's own data. Fix path is a FE-only refactor to consume `useAuth()` user + submissions/enquiries/inspections/documents APIs (or add missing endpoints) instead of literals. Reproduction: log in as any fresh advertiser (must_change_password=true → complete change → hit /advertiser); the identical Kumul Agencies content will appear regardless of the actual account, because the strings are never fetched from the server.
